prose: The Information reports, citing sources, that Palo Alto Networks is in talks to buy three-year-old Israeli startup Clutch Security for around $500M. Clutch makes software for tracking passwords and credentials used by AI agents.
highlights: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy Clutch Security for ~$500M
Clutch tracks credentials used by AI agents
basis: Error cache: The Information paywall. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
